title: Formspec WYSIWYS Ceremony
description: A UI-requirements sidecar for signer ceremonies. The sidecar is an annex over ADR-0136 DocumentArtifact and SignatureSurface contracts and ADR-0141 rendering-service output; it records display and affirmative-action requirements without redefining signed preimage or signature-surface shapes.

$formspecWysiwysCeremony.description: WYSIWYS Ceremony specification version. MUST be '1.0'.

x-lm.intent: Document marker for the WYSIWYS Ceremony sidecar

version.description: Version of this WYSIWYS Ceremony document. SemVer is RECOMMENDED.

targetDefinition.description: The Formspec Definition this ceremony document applies to.

signatureSurfaces.description: Ceremony annex rows for existing ADR-0136 SignatureSurface contracts. Each row binds UI requirements to a referenced surface and DocumentArtifact without redefining either contract.

x-lm.intent: Each ceremony row binds UI controls to an existing signature surface and document artifact

documentArtifactRef.description: Reference to the existing ADR-0136 DocumentArtifact artifactId or artifactRef whose rendered bytes are shown during ceremony.

x-lm.intent: Names the existing rendered document artifact shown during ceremony

documentArtifactContract.description: Contract identifier for the referenced document artifact. This sidecar does not define a local DocumentArtifact shape.

x-lm.intent: Binds the reference to the upstream DocumentArtifact contract instead of a local fork

hashField.description: Existing ADR-0136 DocumentArtifact hash field used as the visual preimage commitment for AuthoredSignature.documentHash.

x-lm.intent: Selects the upstream artifact hash field rather than redefining a digest object

authoredSignatureBinding.description: Existing Formspec authored-signature field that consumes the referenced DocumentArtifact hash commitment.

renderingServiceContract.description: Optional contract identifier for the rendering-service adapter that produced the DocumentArtifact.

required.description: A WYSIWYS ceremony MUST require a scroll gate.

x-lm.intent: Prevents signature capture before full-surface review opportunity

completion.description: Completion rule for the scroll gate.

mode.description: Each ceremony field requires its own affirmative act.

displayExactPreimage.description: The signer MUST see the exact referenced DocumentArtifact whose hash is bound through AuthoredSignature.documentHash.

x-lm.intent: Binds visual review to the existing signed-preimage contract

singleClickAdoptAndSign.description: A single click that adopts all fields and signs is non-conforming.

bulkApply.description: Bulk application of signature or initial fields is non-conforming.

typedNameAsSoleAct.description: Typed-name capture MUST NOT be the sole affirmative act.

fieldRef.description: Formspec path, item key, or ADR-0136 SignatureSurface bindPath covered by this ceremony act.

act.description: Affirmative act required for this field.

surfaceRef.description: Reference to the existing ADR-0136 SignatureSurface.surfaceId or URI this ceremony row governs.

x-lm.intent: References the upstream signature surface instead of declaring a local replacement

signatureSurfaceContract.description: Contract identifier for the referenced signature surface. This sidecar does not define a local SignatureSurface shape.

x-lm.intent: Binds the ceremony row to the upstream SignatureSurface contract

surfaceName.description: Human-readable surface name for ceremony display and audit reports.

fields.description: Per-field affirmative acts required on this surface.
